Name: Complete Item Randomizer (Chaos Mode)
Author: monteduablo24
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com[/img][/center]
[b]Ever felt that farming in Stardew Valley is too predictable?[/b] 
Not anymore! With [color=#ff0000][b]Random Seed Chaos[/b][/color], every seed packet you plant is a mystery box. 
[h2]How it works:[/h2]
This mod intercepts the data for all seeds in the game. When you plant them, the game pulls a random item ID from the pool. 
[list]
[*] [b]High Stakes:[/b] You might plant a Sunflower and get a Starfruit... or a piece of Trash.
[*] [b]Perfect for Challenges:[/b] Try to finish the Community Center when you can't control what you grow!
[*] [b]Lightweight:[/b] No complex scripts, just pure Content Patcher magic.
[/list]
[h2]Requirements:[/h2]
To run this mod, you [u]MUST[/u] have these installed:
1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com]SMAPI[/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com]Content Patcher[/url]
[h2]Installation:[/h2]
1. Download the ZIP file.
2. Extract the "RandomSeedChaos" folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.
3. Launch the game via SMAPI.
4. Pray to the RNG gods!
[i]If you like this mod, please endorse it! It helps me stay motivated to create more chaos.[/i]
